project_type: MERN-stack clinic management system — Node.js/Express 5 backend + React 19/Vite frontend. Migration target: MongoDB Atlas → Supabase PostgreSQL.
language: JavaScript (CommonJS — NO ESM; no 'type: module' in package.json)
build_system: No build step for backend. npm scripts: 'start' = node index.js, 'dev' = nodemon index.js. Run from Backend/ directory.
test_framework: No test framework configured. Verification is manual: start server with 'node index.js' from Backend/ and test endpoints with curl or the frontend.
build_command: cd Backend && npm install && node index.js
test_command: cd Backend && node index.js (observe startup logs; no automated tests)
verification_instructions: 1. cd Backend && npm install. 2. Ensure Backend/.env has SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY. 3. node index.js — must print '[DB] Supabase connected successfully' and '[Seed] Database seeding complete!'. 4. Test key endpoints: POST /api/auth/login, GET /api/patients, POST /api/patients, GET /api/appointments, GET /api/stats/dashboard. 5. Confirm no 'require mongoose' errors or 'Cannot find module' errors.
environment_constraints: Backend/.env must exist with SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY before any Supabase call works. The SQL migration (Backend/src/config/migration.sql) must be run in Supabase SQL editor ONCE before server starts. Windows workspace; use PowerShell paths with backslashes in shell but forward slashes are fine in JS require() calls.
contribution_requirements: All files use CommonJS (require/module.exports). No ESM imports. No TypeScript. Match existing code style: 2-space indent, single quotes, no semicolons optional. Express 5 asyncHandler already wraps all route handlers — do not add try/catch in route handlers.
key_patterns: 1. Services use toFrontendShape() helper functions to normalize DB rows to API response shapes — these shapes MUST be preserved exactly. 2. All services have getDefaultClinic() — replace all with clinicDb.getDefaultClinic(). 3. Monetary values are stored in PAISE (integer); divide by 100 for display. 4. All IDs are UUID strings after migration (not MongoDB ObjectIds). 5. isValidUUID() replaces mongoose.Types.ObjectId.isValid(). 6. Sequential numbers (APT-YYYY-NNNN etc.) are generated by PostgreSQL sequences via DEFAULT — do NOT pass these fields in INSERT payloads; read them back via RETURNING. 7. Supabase JS client: supabase.from('table').select/insert/update/delete for simple ops; supabase.rpc() or raw SQL for complex queries. 8. Frontend expects specific response shapes (see phase3-plan.md Section 10).
directory_structure: Backend/ — entry point is index.js; src/app.js sets up Express middleware; src/config/ has env.js (dotenv), db.js (DB connect), seed.js (seed data), supabase.js (NEW — to create); src/middleware/ has authMiddleware.js, asyncHandler.js, validateRequest.js; src/services/ has all business logic; src/routes/ has Express routers; src/models/ has 15 Mongoose models (DELETE in FEAT-004); src/utils/ has ApiError.js, ApiResponse.js, generateToken.js, scheduler.js, whatsapp.js; src/db/ (NEW — create in FEAT-002) will hold all Supabase query functions.
